rust_summary: the client's level made and dropped (`native_client_level_load`, `native_client_level_unload`).
doc_summary: the client's level made and dropped, on the window: `native_client_level_load(dimension)` when the client makes a level, on joining a server (single player's own included) and on changing dimension (NeoForge's `LevelEvent.Load` from the `ClientLevel` constructor), and `native_client_level_unload(dimension)` when it drops one, replaced by another dimension's (told after the new one's load, as `Minecraft.setLevel` does) or on leaving the server (`LevelEvent.Unload`). Each load has one unload, except when the game itself quits. Bundles that use them need "hooks": @API:client_level_events@.
